WORKFLOW OVERVIEW
PATHOLOGY & SPECIAL REPORTS

A careful path from entry to release.

Structured laboratory results and narrative reports follow a clear review process, with previous versions retained when corrections are needed.

01

Tests & reference ranges

Define tests, panels, parameters, units, age- and sex-dependent ranges, and critical limits.

02

Flexible result entry

Enter numeric, dropdown, and free-text results. Abnormal and critical flags help draw attention to configured thresholds.

03

Independent verification

Move from draft to verified to released. The person who entered a result cannot verify their own entry.

04

Amendments & history

Give a reason for a correction; preserve earlier released versions and require fresh verification.

05

Branded PDF reports

Print or download released reports with center branding, ranges, flags, signatures, and an amended marker when applicable.

06

Narrative reports

Use text templates for imaging and special tests with an optional image or PDF attachment. PACS, DICOM, and an advanced image viewer are outside scope.

✳

Flags are workflow aids based on configured limits; clinical interpretation remains the responsibility of qualified staff.
